title: ScenePilot-Bench: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Evaluation of Vision-Language Models in Autonomous Driving
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for technical autonomous driving tasks such as scene understanding, spatial perception, and motion planning. Although it includes 'risk assessment' and 'safety-aware metrics,' these are treated as engineering and safety-critical performance benchmarks rather than as a study of religion, morals, or philosophical ethics.
